title: /powerup Interactive Feature Tutorial Command
description: /powerup is a new built-in slash command in Claude Code v2.1.90 that provides interactive lessons teaching Claude Code features through animated demos. Designed for hands-on onboarding — users explore capabilities interactively rather than reading static documentation. Not scriptable or automatable (interactive UI only). Primarily an education/discoverability tool for surfacing built-in features that may slip through the heartbeat investigation.
redundancy_notes: No existing interactive tutorial system in registry. Closest overlap: helpers/playbooks (static docs), CLAUDE.md instructions — not interactive. Classification: NOVEL.

evaluation.reasoning: Zero integration cost — built-in command, nothing to install or configure. Full community validation as official Anthropic v2.1.90 feature. Capability expansion is moderate (40): /powerup is educational/discoverability only, not a pipeline tool or automatable capability. Value is indirect — running it periodically may surface built-in features that slip through the heartbeat. Token efficiency neutral. Integration action: document in registry as available command, run /powerup once to check for capabilities not yet in the registry. Maintenance: zero (built-in).
